messages.subject: joint posteriori of the parameters
parts:
Hi,
I'm new to inla and can't figure out how to find the joint posterior distribution of the model parameters.
I work with a model of leroux (spatial) :
formula<- y ~ f(id.area, model="besagproper2",graph=g,
hyper=prior)
mod.leroux=inla(formula, data,family="poisson")

# The vector of parameter is:
x=(\beta, \phi, \rho, \tau)
And i want P(x | Y,W), the posteriori distribution of LGF


Thank you
